target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Travis — wild records from Reimers Ranch and Austin-area references. Williamson — dedicated county vascular-flora treatment.
target_zone_range.blocking_issue: A third exact target-zone native county was not locked in this pass.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Plant-sale/native-gardening lists from Hays or Bell do not prove wild native county occurrence and are not counted.

morphology.look_here_first: Start with the perennial clump and the leaves. Lanceleaf coreopsis is a rhizomatous perennial with mostly basal/lower lanceolate leaves, long nearly leafless peduncles, and large all-yellow heads.
diagnostic_traits: basal and lower-stem leaves lanceolate to oblanceolate
upper leaves sparse, sometimes weakly lobed
large yellow heads without the strong maroon basal ray patches typical of many annual Coreopsis
inner phyllaries broader and united near base

comparisons.key_distinctions: Unlike annual C. wrightii, C. lanceolata is perennial and clump-forming with broader lanceolate lower leaves and long nearly leafless flower stalks.
